descriptor: Sliding tile puzzle with cosy colours

voice.summary: Merge Lane talks like a friendly game host: quick, upbeat and never smug about a loss. It celebrates a good merge and treats a stuck board as a reason to try again.
dos: Keep prompts to four words or fewer
Celebrate merges with a short, specific cheer
Say what to do next after every outcome

taglines: Make it to the top tile
boilerplate: Merge Lane is a cosy sliding tile puzzle with soft colours, smooth animations and a colour-blind-friendly palette, made for a few relaxing minutes.

microcopy.error: No more moves. Try a new board.
microcopy.empty: Swipe or press an arrow key to begin.

logo.note: A simple cube echoes the tiles that slide and merge on the board.
